Third-party code bundled in the JXPilot release client jar (LWJGL 3.3.6 and its native libraries).
Texts copied from https://github.com/LWJGL/lwjgl3/tree/3.3.6 unless noted.

  lwjgl_license.txt    LWJGL 3 (BSD 3-Clause)                  LICENSE.md
  glfw_license.txt     GLFW, in lwjgl-glfw natives (zlib)      modules/lwjgl/glfw/glfw_license.txt
  khronos_license.txt  Khronos OpenGL headers (MIT-style)      modules/lwjgl/opengl/khronos_license.txt
  libffi_license.txt   libffi, in lwjgl core natives (MIT)     modules/lwjgl/core/libffi_license.txt
  liburing_license.txt liburing, in Linux core natives (MIT)   modules/lwjgl/core/liburing_license.txt
  stb_license.txt      stb, in lwjgl-stb natives (MIT or public domain), from github.com/nothings/stb
